rule: Every weak, stale, reverted, blocked, or pending learning-quality signal must become an owner-visible action before recommendation confidence compounds again.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, booking commission, payment-custody signal, tenant-private memory, or unowned learning action can reach recommendation weights in phase one.
action_principles: Convert weak learning quality signals into owner-visible tasks.
Keep one next action beside each accepted, reverted, blocked, stale, or pending quality state.
Assign each action to a buyer, supplier, founder, or operator owner before weights move.
Attach the source audit event and rollback state to every action.
Separate supplier nudges, proof refreshes, review holds, rollback tasks, and scale holds.
Track blocked payment-custody routes as protection tasks, not monetization opportunities.
Require completion or explicit hold before shared learning confidence compounds again.

role_action_queues.primary_action: review proof conflict before proof freshness weight increases
role_action_queues.rollback_task: restore prior supplier rank if proof stays conflicted

role_action_queues.primary_action: send freshness nudge before listing visibility increases
role_action_queues.rollback_task: restore prior listing visibility if proof remains stale

role_action_queues.primary_action: hold scale until weak wedge response quality improves
role_action_queues.rollback_task: restore prior market queue if wedge stays weak

acceptance: Marketplace shows the Learning Action Queue after the Learning Quality Dashboard.
Buyer, supplier, and founder views each show owner, source quality, primary action, due state, rollback task, blocked task, and completion gate.
Copy output explains the queue event, owner, source quality, next action, due state, rollback, completion gate, and blocked payment route.
Build Phase shows the v174 Learning Action Queue contract after the Learning Quality Dashboard contract.
Docs include action states, action routes, private routes, blocked payment routes, and required action fields.
Static check fails if the queue UI, contract, JSON model, cache-bust token, or render functions are missing.
No shared learning confidence can compound without an owned action or explicit hold in phase one.
